function strings(a: Record<string, number>, b: Record<string, number>) {
  const c = { ...a, ...b } as const;
  c.x = 2;
  console.log(c.x);
}
strings({ x: 1 }, {});
function numbers(a: Record<number, number>, b: Record<number, number>) {
  const c = { ...a, ...b } as const;
  c[0] = 2;
  console.log(c[0]);
}
numbers({ 0: 1 }, {});
function alternatives(a: Record<string, number> | Record<string, string>, b: Record<string, number>) {
  const c = { ...a, ...b } as const;
  c.y = 3;
}
function writable(a: Record<string, number>, b: Record<string, number>) {
  const c = { ...a, ...b };
  c.z = 4;
}
function written(k: string, b: Record<string, number>) {
  const c = { [k]: 1, ...b } as const;
  c.w = 5;
}
